dataList.content:
You... What are you doing?
你们……在做什么？
dataList.place:
Catherine's Room
凯瑟琳的房间

dataList.content:
The room, now without its master, was completely turned upside-down.
早已失去主人的房间如今已一片狼藉。

And in the center of all that mess were Butlers, awkwardly standing, frozen mid-movement as though they'd all been caught red-handed.
在那房间正中，管家们一副正做见不得光的事情被发现般的神色，呆呆立在原地。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
... We were cleaning the room, as per Master Linton's orders.
……遵循林顿家主的要求，正在对房间进行清理。

You lot were clearly ransacking the room!
任谁来看你们都是在搜查这房间吧！

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
... Chief Butler Nelly, have you seen any of the Dead Rabbits or the Wuthering Heights Butlers on your way here?
……您一路上没有见到过死兔帮的人，或者呼啸山庄的管家们吗，耐莉大人。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
We have good reason to believe that the Wuthering Heights Butlers are scheming with that villain Hindley to harm Master Linton.
看上去亨德利……和死兔帮那些家伙有所勾结，想要对林顿家主不利。

... The Dead Rabbits ain’t the type of gang to kill people for no reason.
……死兔帮不是那种无缘无故就杀人的集团。

Okay, but they did try to kill us for no reason.
但是你那些好伙伴们确实无缘无故攻击我们了吧。

I know, dammit! The boss can't be doing all this for nothing. He must have a good explanation for this.
我也知道！大哥一定是有什么理由才会这样的。

Just tell us what dodgy shite you were up to in Catherine's room.
告诉我你们在凯瑟琳的房间里谋划些什么。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
We told you, Heathcliff. We were... cleaning the room.
我们说过……是在打扫房间，希斯克利夫。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
Or have you sided yourself with the rest of those lowlives, the Dead Rabbits?
还是说你们也勾结了死兔帮那群下等人？

Like Master, like Butlers, eh? Just as stupid and soft as Linton himself.
不愧是在那个温室里长大的林顿手底下做事的家伙，跟他一样听不懂人话。

dataList.title:
Edgar Family
埃德加家族
dataList.content:
That was uncalled for.
你话说太过了。

No. This dodgy shite you're trying to pull here is what's uncalled for. You've crossed the line.
错了，不管是把话说过了的还是大摇大摆越界的人都是你们。

I’m the only one who can tell you what to do with this room. Not that posh wanker.
只有我才能允许你们在这个房间东搞西搞，而不是那个怂包。
